pois.name: USCGC Ingham Maritime Museum
pois.description: USCGC INGHAM fought the Battle of the Atlantic as a convoy escort, she sank U-boat U-626, with single depth charge. INGHAM also served as flagship during amphibious landings in the Philippines as well as the Vietnam War.
pois.intro: USCGC Ingham is one of only two preserved Treasury-class United States Coast Guard Cutters. Originally Samuel D. Ingham, she was the fourth cutter to be named for Treasury Secretary Samuel D. Ingham.

The Ernest Hemmingway Home and Museum
pois.intro: The Ernest Hemingway House was the residence of American writer Ernest Hemingway in the 1930s. The house is situated on the island of Key West, Florida.

pois.name: Fort Zachary Taylor Historic State Park
pois.address: 601 Howard England Way, Key West, FL, 33040
pois.intro: The Fort Zachary Taylor Historic State Park, also known simply as Fort Taylor, is a Florida State Park and National Historic Landmark centered on a Civil War-era fort located near the southern tip of Key West, Florida.

pois.name: Sloppy Joe's Bar
pois.intro: Sloppy Joe's Bar is a historic American bar in Key West, Florida, located at the corner of Greene and Duval Street since 1937. A frequent haunt of famous writer Ernest Hemingway, it is now home to the annual Hemingway Days celebration and its Hemingway Look-Alike Contest.

pois.name: Mel Fisher Maritime Museum
pois.description: Naval storehouse, used as a warehouse, administrative offices, and later as a U.S. Navy Post Office.
pois.intro: The Mel Fisher Maritime Museum is located at 200 Greene Street, Key West, Florida. The museum contains an extensive collection of artifacts from 17th century shipwrecks, such as the Henrietta Marie, Nuestra Señora de Atocha and Santa Margarita.

pois.name: Southernmost Point Buoy
pois.address: Whitehead St &, South St, Key West, FL 33040
pois.description: Simple buoy-shaped monument located at the southernmost tip of the continental U.S. & 90 miles north of Cuba. est. 1983 the "publicly accessible" southernmost point in the continental United States
pois.intro: The Southernmost Point Buoy is an anchored concrete buoy in Key West, Florida that claims to mark the southernmost point in the continental United States — though it is neither the true southernmost point of the continental US nor of Key West — and was established as a tourist attraction by the city on September 10, 1983.

pois.name: Key West Museum of Art and History at the Custom House
pois.description: Custom House was the site of many significant historical events, most notably the inquiry into the sinking of the USS Maine in Havana harbor in 1898. Customs, Postal Service, and U.S. District courts relocated in 1932. Transferred to the Navy in 1932.
pois.wikipedia: en:Old Post Office and Customshouse (Key West, Florida)
pois.intro: The Custom House and Old Post Office is a historic site located at 281 Front Street, Key West, Florida, United States. On September 20, 1973, it was added to the U.S. National Register of Historic Places.

pois.name: Truman Little White House
pois.intro: The Harry S. Truman Little White House in Key West, Florida, United States, was the winter White House for President Harry S. Truman for 175 days during 11 visits. The house is located in the Truman Annex neighborhood of Old Town, Key West.

pois.name: Key West Butterfly & Nature Conservatory
pois.wikipedia: en:Key West Butterfly and Nature Conservatory
pois.intro: The Key West Butterfly and Nature Conservatory located at 1316 Duval Street, Key West, Florida, United States is a butterfly park that houses from 50 to 60 different species of live butterflies from around the world in a climate-controlled, glass-enclosed habitat. The conservatory includes flowering plants, cascading waterfalls and trees.

pois.name: Key West Aquarium
pois.intro: The Key West Aquarium is the only public aquarium in Key West, Florida, United States. It is located at 1 Whitehead Street and is marked by Historic Marker 52.

pois.name: Shipwreck Treasures
pois.intro: The Key West Shipwreck Museum is located in Key West, Florida, United States. It combines actors, films and actual artifacts to tell the story of 400 years of shipwreck salvage in the Florida Keys.

pois.name: Mallory Square
pois.intro: Mallory Square is a plaza located in the city of Key West, Florida. It is located on the waterfront in Key West's historic Old Town, adjacent to the cruise ship port.

pois.name: Audubon House and Tropical Gardens
pois.intro: The Audubon House & Tropical Gardens is located at 205 Whitehead Street, Key West, Florida. Brick-pathed gardens offer a lush 1-acre view of orchids, bromeliads, and other tropical foliage, an herb garden and 1840-style nursery.

pois.intro: The U.S. Coast Guard Headquarters, Key West Station is a historic site in Key West, Florida. It is located at the northwest corner of the intersection of Front and Whitehead Streets.

pois.intro: The Key West Tropical Forest & Botanical Garden is a frost-free arboretum and botanical garden containing a collection of trees, shrubs, and palms, including several "champion tree" specimens. It is located on Stock Island in the municipality of Key West, Florida, United States.
